newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Environmental gives fire costs.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Environmental gives fire costs.

text.p: Advanced Environmental Recycling Technologies Inc said on Monday that it estimated a September 1 fire at its Arkansas plastics reclamation facility would cost $332,761.

The company said it estimated raw materials lost in the fire cost $124,600 and equipment damage and relocation cost $208,161, but costs were covered by insurance. A leased storage area near the production facility was also destroyed.
It also said it experienced reduced operating efficiencies at the plant after the fire.
Advanced Environmental said it began to rebuild the sites, and the plant was due to return to full production in early December. The company also said it increased security there.
